subject: general
question: In 2025, the Central Government granted a one-year extension to Dr. Samir V Kamat, extending his tenure as Chief of which organisation till May 2026?

options.text: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** is an agency under the **Ministry of Defence** of the Government of India.
 
• It was established in **1958** with its headquarters in **New Delhi**.
 
• DRDO is tasked with developing **defense technologies**, including military hardware, systems, and solutions to enhance the nation's security.
 
• It is involved in designing and producing a wide range of equipment, including **missiles, radars, electronic warfare systems, aircrafts, and combat vehicles**.
 
• **Dr. Samir V Kamat** is a prominent scientist in the field of **materials engineering** and was appointed as the Chairman of DRDO.
 
• His tenure extension till **May 2026** reflects the government's trust in his leadership and contributions to enhancing India's defense capabilities.
 
• DRDO collaborates with several **national and international organizations** and industries to integrate cutting-edge technologies.
 
• Its notable projects include **BrahMos missile, Agni series, and Light Combat Aircraft (Tejas).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**__

 __
 
• **ISRO** is India's national space agency headquartered in **Bangalore**.
 
• Founded in **1969**, ISRO is responsible for developing and launching satellites and space exploration missions.
 
• It has successfully launched missions such as **Chandrayaan (Moon Mission)** and **Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission).**
 
• ISRO focuses on research in **space science, satellite communication, remote sensing, and navigation.**
 
 
 
• **National Security Council Secretariat (NSCS)**__
 __
 
• NSCS is an organization under the **National Security Council of India.**
 
• It primarily focuses on **strategic coordination and national security policies.**
 
• The NSCS provides inputs on **defense, internal security, and economic security.**
 
• It plays a vital role in advising the government on **national security matters.**
 
 
 
• **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)**__
 
 
• **CSIR** is one of the world's largest research and development organizations, headquartered in **New Delhi.**
 
• It was established in **1942** and operates under the Ministry of Science and Technology.
 
• CSIR focuses on research in areas like **biotechnology, chemicals, environment, energy, and aerospace.**
 
• It has contributed to innovations such as **drug development, industrial processes, and environmental solutions.**
